name: Fiscal.ai
description: Access institutional-grade financial data directly within Claude. Fiscal.ai delivers fundamental metrics and ratios minutes after earnings are reported, with every figure verifiable via direct links to the source filing. Beyond core financials, the server provides company-specific KPIs, revenue segments, and adjusted metrics. Combined with historical and current market quotes, it enables grounded, audit-ready equity research with unmatched speed.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Fiscal.ai to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Fiscal.ai to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.fiscal.ai/mcp/sse. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Fiscal.ai MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Fiscal.ai provides these MCP tools: api_docs and execute_code.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Fiscal.ai?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Fiscal.ai in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.
Fiscal.ai requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Fiscal.ai is developed by Fiscal.ai. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
